guide.title: 参与前安全检查
guide.description: 核对官方域名后再操作。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。任何要求你输入助记词、私钥或向个人地址转账的页面都是骗局。
guide.done_when: 已确认官方域名，并准备好专用的独立空投钱包。

guide.title: Check Which Wallet Holds Your Doppler Points
guide.description: Open the Doppler Finance app and connect the XRPL wallet you deposited with, whether that was Girin, Xaman, Bifrost or Crossmark. The Points tab shows your DP balance from both seasons. Eligibility is tied to the address that earned the points, so register with this wallet and no other.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Open the XDP Genesis Airdrop Portal
guide.description: Go to the official $XDP Airdrop portal . Doppler links it from its own X account and site, so check the domain before signing anything. Token launch pages attract copycat sites; our safety guide covers the warning signs.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Connect the Wallet Holding Your Points
guide.description: Connect the same wallet from Step 1 and approve the signature request. The portal reads your DP balance and shows whether the address qualifies.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Submit a Base Network Address You Control
guide.description: Enter a Base address you hold the private keys for. Three things will cost you the allocation: Exchange deposit addresses, which cannot receive an airdrop claim Smart contract addresses Addresses on a network Doppler does not support Submissions cannot be edited after confirmation, so read the address back before you sign.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Fund the Base Address With Gas
guide.description: Claiming at TGE happens on Base and costs a small amount of ETH. You can buy it on Bybit and withdraw straight to Base, or move ETH you already hold across using the widget below. Bridge funds Swap and bridge across 30+ chains without leaving this page. Fast routes, low fees. Bridge now Opens an interactive bridge widget Open the bridge in a new tab
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Confirm and Record Your Registration
guide.description: Approve the final confirmation in the portal, then save a screenshot of the confirmed address and the transaction hash. That record is what Doppler support will ask for.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Watch for the Claim Window
guide.description: Registration is not a claim. Tokens become claimable at TGE, and Doppler has not published a date. Follow the project on X and check our claims page so you catch the window.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

需要。请务必使用独立的空投钱包。
需要少量主网资产用于支付 Gas。

faq.q: 积分一定会兑换 Token 吗？
faq.a: 不一定。积分与 Token 之间没有必然兑换关系，请勿将全部精力投入单一项目。
存在一定风险，新手请务必先阅读风险提示再决定。

risks: 项目尚未确认空投，存在投入后无回报的可能。
真实性置信度偏低，证据不足，建议先观察。
任何要求输入助记词、私钥或恢复短语的页面都不可信。
请勿使用主钱包参与实验性项目，避免资产集中风险。
